intrinsics_to_fullseye — DRIVE carla op

• Data kinds: matrix → matrix

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.intrinsics_to_fullseye(K) -> 'np.ndarray' (to call the implementation directly, import carlabridge; carlabridge.intrinsics_to_fullseye(K) -> 'np.ndarray'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("intrinsics_to_fullseye"))

Usage

CARLA K (pixel corners at integers, principal point W/2) → Fullseye / render3d K (pixel centers at integers, principal point (W−1)/2). Just shifts the principal point by 0.5.
